description: Test signal generator whose output keeps changing shape, amplitude and character on its own, written for stress-testing modules and usable as a source of unpredictable modulation or of harsh audio

params.text: Sets the frequency of the generated signal, over a wide range from slow control voltages up to audio rate
Sets how often a new shape is picked, slowly counter-clockwise and several times a second clockwise; each change chooses a random waveform, a stepped random voltage or white noise
Scales the output, silent at zero, with a quadratic response that gives fine control over small modulation voltages in the lower half and signals well above 5V at the top
